# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>; Rev. Jo  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Jonas is an ugly, plain man with tow-colored hair. His radiant happiness makes him not seem plain, and he is described as having niceness exuding from him.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P13](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0013), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jo is a pleasant, good-natured minister who enjoys laughing and joking, making up his mind quickly when faced with decisions. He possesses a strong sense of purpose, choosing to serve in the slums, and is deeply devoted to his wife.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Traits

- Loves to laugh and joke  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Quick-minded and decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>
- Devoted to his ministry and family  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Preaching and offering moving prayers  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve in a mission church in the Patterson Street slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)</sub>

## History

Jonas graduated from Redmond College and later attended St. Columbia to enter the ministry. During a summer break, he stayed near Philippa Gordon, spending time fishing, boating, and preaching in the local village church. Philippa fell in love with him despite her initial inclination toward wealthy suitors, and they became engaged, planning for Jonas to take a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums after his graduation. Following his graduation from St. Columbia, he married Philippa Gordon in June, with Anne Shirley serving as a bridesmaid, and set out for a lovers' saunter in the land of Evangeline before moving to Patterson Street. Years later, he and Philippa visited Green Gables prior to Anne's wedding, where he delivered a deeply admired wedding prayer during the ceremony.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
